title: Target Enrichment via In-Solution Hybridisation Using Twist Bioscience Panels
author: Tina Saupe

steps.title: Clean dsDNA Libraries
steps.instruction: Clean the dsDNA libraries using Ampure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 10 µL of each dsDNA library to new 0.2 mL PCR tubes.
Add 1.8x volume of Ampure XP beads (Beckman Coulter #A63881) to each library.
Mix by briefly pulse-spinning and then quick spin-down.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place tubes on a magnetic rack for 5 minutes until the solution is clear.
While on the rack, remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash the bead pellet 3 times by gently adding 250 µL of 80% ethanol, incubating for 1 minute, and discarding the ethanol.
After the final wash, use a 10 µL pipette to remove all traces of supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Air-dry the pellet on the magnetic rack for 5 to 10 minutes until dry.

steps.title: Prepare Blockers and Probes Master Mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare the required master mixes in 1.5 mL LoBind Eppendorf tubes.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Blockers solution MM: Mix 5.0 µL Blockers solution and 7.0 µL Universal Blockers (Total 12.0 µL per reaction). Resuspend, briefly centrifuge, and store on ice.

Prepare Probes solution MM: Mix 5.0 µL Hybridisation Mix, 1.0 µL Twist Custom panel, 0.5 µL Twist secondary panel, and 3.5 µL nuclease-free molecular biology-grade water (Total 10.0 µL per reaction). Resuspend and briefly centrifuge.
Add 0.1% volume of TWEEN 20 (Merck MilliporeSigma #P7949) to each B&W buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Hybridisation Reaction
steps.instruction: Combine the libraries with blockers and probes for hybridisation.

substeps.instruction: Remove tubes from the magnetic rack and add 12 µL of Blockers solution Master Mix to the dried dsDNA libraries; homogenise by pipetting.
Incubate the Blockers solution reaction tubes at 95 °C for 5 minutes.
Aliquot 10 µL of Probe solution MM to 0.2 µL PCR tubes, briefly spin down, and store on ice.
Incubate the Probe solution MM at 95 °C for 5 minutes in the thermocycler.
Place both Probes and Blockers solution reaction tubes on the bench at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Mix Probes solution by flicking and briefly spin down.
Pipette 10 µL of Probes solution into each Blockers solution reaction tube. Homogenise by pipetting up and down 4-5 times and briefly spin down.
Add 30 µL of Hybridisation Enhancer to the top of the reaction. Homogenise by pipetting up and down 4-5 times and briefly spin down to ensure no bubbles are present.

steps.title: Perform Hybridisation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction in a thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: Place the tubes in the thermal cycler at 65 °C for 16 hours.

steps.title: Capture Hybridised DNA with Streptavidin Beads
steps.instruction: Bind the hybridised DNA to Streptavidin Binding Beads.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 300 µL Streptavidin Binding Beads into 1.5 mL LoBind Eppendorf tubes (change tips for each reaction).
Place tubes on a magnetic rack for 2 minutes until the solution is clear.
Remove and discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Open the thermal cycler lid and quick spin-down the hybridisation reactions.

Transfer each hybridisation reaction (~52 µL) to the cleaned Streptavidin Binding Beads. Mix by pipetting up and down (critical for minimising off-target binding) without letting the reaction cool down.
Incubate the tubes on a table rotator for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Remove from rotator and quick spin-down.

steps.title: Wash Captured DNA
steps.instruction: Wash the bead-bound DNA using B&W buffers.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic rack for 2 minutes until the solution is clear.
Remove and discard the supernatant (this contains the non-enriched library; store in a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube at -20 °C).
Resuspend the bead pellet using 600 µL of 1X B&W buffer 1.
Place on magnetic rack for 2 minutes, then remove and discard the supernatant.
Move the entire volume (~700 µL) into a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube.
Add 700 µL of 1X B&W buffer 1, resuspend by pipetting or flicking, and place on the magnetic rack for 1 minute.
Remove and discard the clear supernatant.

Perform 3 washes: Add 700 µL of 1X B&W buffer 2 (pre-heated to 49 °C), resuspend by pipetting 2-3 times, centrifuge briefly, incubate for 5 minutes at 49 °C, and place on the magnetic rack for 1 minute to discard supernatant.
After the final wash, use a 10 µL pipette to remove all traces of supernatant.

steps.title: Elute Enriched DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the enriched DNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Remove tubes from the magnetic rack and add 45 µL of nuclease-free molecular biology-grade water or EB buffer (Qiagen #19086).
Resuspend briefly by pipetting and incubate on ice.

steps.title: Amplify Enriched Library
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification of the enriched DNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Amplification MM in a 1.5 mL LoBind tube: Mix 25.0 µL Equinox Library Amp Mix (2x) and 2.5 µL Amplification Primer (per 1.05*reagent).
Aliquot 27.5 µL of Amplification MM to 0.2 µL PCR tubes.
Add 22.5 µL of the hybridisation reaction (eluted DNA) to the tubes and quick spin-down.

Run the thermal cycler program: Lid 105 °C; Initialisation 98 °C (45 sec); 15 cycles of [Denaturation 98 °C (15 sec), Annealing 60 °C (30 sec), Extension 72 °C (30 sec)]; Final extension 72 °C (1 min); Hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Final Cleanup and QC
steps.instruction: Perform a final bead cleanup and quantify the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare fresh 80% ethanol and vortex Ampure XP beads (Beckman Coulter #A63881) until homogenised.
Add 90 µL of Ampure XP beads to each 0.2 mL PCR tube, mix by vortexing, and quick spin-down.
Place on a magnetic rack for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant.
Wash the pellet 3 times with 250 µL of 80% ethanol (incubate 1 minute per wash) and discard the ethanol.
Use a 10 µL pipette to remove all traces of supernatant.
Air-dry the pellet on the magnetic rack for 5 to 10 minutes.
Remove from the rack and add 12 µL of EB buffer; homogenise by pipetting.
Use 2 µL of the enriched dsDNA library for concentration measurement using Qubit and Fragment analyser.
